daily_thesis: The 2026-09-18 batch says embodied systems are no longer competing only on better perception or stronger policies; they are competing on when a representation is allowed to control the robot. Geometry papers make maps answer for calibration, compute budget, lighting, cross-agent fusion, and query ambiguity before the map is trusted. Navigation papers separate evidence acquisition from route commitment: active viewpoints, onboard VLN stages, topology memories, target uncertainty, movable-obstacle relocation, and terrain-feeling forecasts all ask what must be known before moving. Manipulation papers split nominal motion from correction authority through tactile world models, future latents, obstacle-aware coding agents, transparent teleoperation, underwater bimanual data, and residual insertion control. Safety and deployment papers then define revocation: adversarial VLA states that persist after a patch, vehicle commands that must not execute, reach-avoid-stay filters, scenario generators, V2X validation, hidden-vehicle minimax search, and quantization gates that accept, reject, or defer deployment. APRL should build evaluation assets where map, language, touch, foresight, safety, and compression modules declare what decision they can change and what evidence removes that authority.

clusters.cluster: Robot maps move from reconstruction output to trust-gated decision state
clusters.why: 기존 3D/SLAM 평가는 pose error나 rendering 품질을 먼저 보았지만, 오늘 묶음은 로봇이 그 map을 언제 믿어도 되는지를 묻는다. AMB3R-SLAM과 VGGT-GS SLAM은 장거리 계층 consistency와 uncalibrated Gaussian refinement를 다루고, EliGSiR와 RawSLAM은 bounded compute와 HDR lighting에서 online map authority가 어떻게 유지되는지 본다. CoRef-GS, Scene-Q, CitySTAR, SenseFuse는 fused map과 open-vocabulary 3D query가 ambiguity, semantic mismatch, spatial relation을 만나면 빠른 retrieval을 믿을지 reasoning으로 넘길지 결정해야 함을 보여준다. 따라서 APRL geometry 평가는 reconstruction score가 아니라 map update, localization, 3D query, manipulation planning을 허가하거나 보류하는 trust gate로 설계되어야 한다.
clusters.confidence_note: Kilometer-scale SLAM, uncalibrated Gaussian SLAM, continual RGB-D mapping, HDR Gaussian SLAM, cooperative referring maps, and confidence-aware 3D querying all repeat the map authority decision.
clusters.lab_action: RGB-D/Gaussian indoor sequence, uncalibrated monocular video, HDR lighting, fused multi-agent map, and large-building floor-plan localization에서 hierarchy level, calibration residual, compute load, HDR exposure, semantic compatibility, and query confidence를 stress split으로 만들고 map-update error, wrong localization, wrong 3D query, and downstream navigation/manipulation failure를 함께 평가한다.

clusters.cluster: Contact-rich manipulation separates nominal motion from correction authority
clusters.why: Manipulation 논문들은 좋은 nominal policy 하나보다, 어떤 correction channel이 언제 행동을 바꿔야 하는지를 묻는다. Obstacle-aware coding agents는 안전 constraint가 trace에 있어도 route/contact planning priority가 되지 않으면 충돌한다는 점을 보이고, DITTO와 ULOHA는 force feedback, bimanual underwater disturbances, action chunking 같은 data-collection and deployment gaps를 드러낸다. clusters.cluster: Safety research moves from static constraints to revocation timing
clusters.why: Safety 논문들은 안전 여부를 마지막 collision label로만 보지 않고, 언제 policy authority를 회수해야 하는지로 바꾼다. clusters.cluster: World-action models and scenario generators become closed-loop evaluation instruments
clusters.why: World model과 scenario generation 논문은 예쁜 미래를 만드는 데서 끝나지 않고, closed-loop failure를 만들어내는 실험 장치가 되고 있다. Astronex-World, MM-Future, JEPA-WAM, GAVEL, HOPHY는 visual instruction, world-action prediction, graph world models, hypergraph planning을 task execution과 연결하고, AR scene transformation과 AdvScene은 안전한 driving slice를 critical interaction으로 바꾼다. OPTED와 parking offline RL은 expensive sensor simulation 없이 closed-loop post-training or waypoint action tokens를 다루려 한다. APRL은 world-action model을 policy generator가 아니라 hypothesis generator로 쓰고, generated scenario가 어떤 failure mode를 실제 closed-loop metric으로 드러내는지 검증해야 한다.

frontier_memory.label: Strengthening
frontier_memory.history: September 17 emphasized evidence contracts for VLA action interfaces, geometry trust, contact correction, runtime safety, and edge deployment.
frontier_memory.body: September 18 strengthens the same axis, but moves from action interfaces toward map/query/navigation authority: geometry and VLM reasoning repeatedly become gated resources.

frontier_memory.label: New signal
frontier_memory.history: Recent editions had many geometry and VLA trust signals, but less explicit attention to unknown-space navigation and relocation decisions.
frontier_memory.body: NAMO under unknown environments, spatial-semantic target search, coordinate-free VLN, and VA-Bench point to evidence acquisition before route commitment as a standalone research asset.

frontier_memory.label: Commoditizing
frontier_memory.history: Gaussian splatting, feed-forward 3D, and world-action model deployment now appear almost daily.
frontier_memory.body: The differentiator is no longer using 3DGS or WAM, but whether the system exposes calibration, compute budget, ambiguity, or degradation gates that change robot decisions.

frontier_memory.label: Contradiction
frontier_memory.history: Large generalist models are often assumed to solve more of the robot stack end to end.
frontier_memory.body: Today's papers push back: VLN on the Fly keeps modular stages, Scene-Q invokes VLM reasoning selectively, PreDE sometimes defers compression decisions, and vehicle assistants must often refuse to act.

frontier_memory.label: Missing axis
frontier_memory.history: The repo has strong daily signals for maps, navigation, safety, contact, and deployment, but they remain evaluated in separate artifact families.
frontier_memory.body: A single deferral-and-revocation benchmark is missing: one suite should ask when maps, language decisions, tactile forecasts, navigation evidence, and compressed WAMs are allowed to control execution.

strategy_board.title: Deferral and revocation benchmark for robot decision authority
strategy_board.thesis: Build a suite where maps, VLM queries, navigation plans, tactile predictions, safety filters, and deployment-compressed policies must expose when they should act, defer, or be revoked.
strategy_board.one_week: Prototype three gates: Scene-Q-style 3D query deferral, VA-Bench-style active viewpoint selection, and PreDE-style compression accept/reject/defer on one robot policy log.
strategy_board.four_week: Unify geometry confidence, target-search uncertainty, tactile foresight, adversarial recoverability, CBF intervention, and deployment degradation into one decision-authority schema.
strategy_board.success: At least three gates predict or prevent failures earlier than terminal task success while reducing unnecessary intervention.
strategy_board.stop: Stop if gates merely correlate with generic confidence and do not change action, map update, query escalation, or deployment decisions.
strategy_board.paper_path: Benchmark and analysis paper on deferral, correction, and revocation as robot intelligence primitives.
strategy_board.asset_path: Authority-labeled episodes, uncertainty traces, map-query ambiguity labels, compression decisions, recovery latency annotations, and safety-filter intervention logs.
strategy_board.asset: Authority-labeled episodes, uncertainty traces, map-query ambiguity labels, compression decisions, recovery latency annotations, and safety-filter intervention logs.

strategy_board.title: Robot-usable Gaussian map trust gate
strategy_board.thesis: Turn Gaussian SLAM and feed-forward 3D outputs into map-update, localization, and query-authority decisions rather than passive reconstructions.
strategy_board.one_week: Compare AMB3R-style hierarchy, VGGT-GS calibration, EliGSiR compute scheduling, and Scene-Q query confidence on one RGB-D indoor sequence.
strategy_board.four_week: Add HDR lighting, partial map fusion, multi-agent referring queries, and unknown-building floor-plan localization to create a trust-gate evaluation set.
strategy_board.success: Trust gates reduce harmful map updates, wrong 3D queries, or failed localization while preserving useful online mapping throughput.
strategy_board.stop: Stop if gates improve reconstruction metrics but do not change navigation, querying, or manipulation outcomes.
strategy_board.paper_path: Robot mapping paper centered on when 3D state should be trusted, escalated, or rejected.
strategy_board.asset_path: RGB-D/Gaussian maps, uncalibrated/HDR sequences, cross-agent query episodes, ambiguity labels, and downstream decision outcomes.
strategy_board.asset: RGB-D/Gaussian maps, uncalibrated/HDR sequences, cross-agent query episodes, ambiguity labels, and downstream decision outcomes.

strategy_board.title: Contact and foresight correction stack
strategy_board.thesis: Separate nominal manipulation actions from tactile, future-latent, obstacle, teleoperation, underwater, and residual-correction signals.
strategy_board.one_week: Run one manipulation task with tactile prediction, movement-trend latent, obstacle-aware planner veto, and residual local correction ablations.
strategy_board.four_week: Add human-touch pretraining, high-DOF teleoperation data, underwater bimanual perturbations, and book-insertion contact correction into a shared correction benchmark.
strategy_board.success: Correction channels predict slip, collision, jamming, or unsafe contact before nominal policy failure and improve recovery timing.
strategy_board.stop: Stop if extra channels raise average success but cannot explain which failure mode they corrected.
strategy_board.paper_path: Manipulation paper on explicit correction authority across touch, foresight, and safety constraints.
strategy_board.asset_path: Tactile/video pairs, future-latent logs, obstacle-veto traces, teleoperation force feedback, underwater demos, and residual correction labels.
strategy_board.asset: Tactile/video pairs, future-latent logs, obstacle-veto traces, teleoperation force feedback, underwater demos, and residual correction labels.
